suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam repricing numbers confirmation and devnet-8 launch readiness
suggestions.rationale: Repricing numbers were deferred to ACDE (expected this week per ACDT #91). DevNet 8 (Platåberget) launch is blocked until numbers are final, and this is a public-facing testnet that cannot undergo a second repricing. Critical path item.

suggestions.topic: Gas limit bump proposal for Glamsterdam fork
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDT #91 with no resolution. Proposal to bump default gas limit to 200M at fork to prevent pre-fork transactions failing post-repricing, but CL teams raised concerns about dual-flag complexity. Barnabas was to draft alternative proposal.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8070 Engine API spec alignment with potuz and ACDC discussion
suggestions.rationale: Action from ACDT #90 to confirm spec changes with potuz and bring to ACDC agenda remains open. While EIP-8070 was confirmed mandatory for devnet-8 in ACDT #91, concerns about FCU placement were unresolved. Needs closure before devnet-8.

suggestions.topic: DevNet 7 stability and readiness for devnet-8 transition
suggestions.rationale: DevNet 7 has been stable for weeks, but payload-flooding attack discovered in ACDT #91 showed missing IGNORE rules in some clients. Confirmation that all clients have implemented the duplicate envelope fix and are ready for devnet-8 testing.

suggestions.topic: Circuit breaker implementation status across CL clients
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #91 showed Teku implemented for devnet-8, Nimbus porting Fusaka design, but Lighthouse update missing. Broader action from ACDT #89 for bid-selection logging improvements not fully confirmed. Status check needed before devnet-8.

suggestions.topic: DevNet 8 (Platåberget) scope and optional testing (SNAP2, stateful deltas)
suggestions.rationale: DevNet 8 spec includes 70 MB genesis SSZ state test and Barnabas requested optional SNAP2/stateful deltas testing (EIP-8136, EIP-8189). Confirm final scope and whether optional features are ready for inclusion.
Action item from ACDT #91 for lightclient to approve EIPs/pull/12021 to unblock EIP-8282 updates for Glamsterdam. Recent action with unclear urgency; check if resolved or still blocking.

suggestions.topic: Formal SFI status ratification for devnet-7 EIPs
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDT #88 to 'next ACDE/ACDC Thursday' (after July 20). No confirmation in subsequent ACDT calls. While this may have been handled on ACDE/ACDC, worth confirming closure or current status.
